verdict.rationale: Weave ships a code-driven Evaluation API (Dataset plus scorers, built-in and custom), and the vendor explicitly positions it to measure performance against repeatable test cases and catch regressions before they reach users. That makes running evals programmatically plausible, but no evidence documents CI usage or deployment gating. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration (e.g. GitHub Actions example), pass/fail thresholds or exit codes for gating deployments, independent or hands-on corroboration.
